# AXIOM Command Center

> Explore AXIOM, a bold SaaS website demo with illustrated product modules, sample case studies, and interactive monthly and annual pricing.

## About this demonstration

This is a fictional marketing demonstration. Forms and prices do not create accounts, messages, subscriptions, orders, or payments.

## Pages

- [AXIOM Command Center — SaaS Website Demo](https://vibed-saas-bold.xavainf.com/): Explore AXIOM, a bold SaaS website demo with illustrated product modules, sample case studies, and interactive monthly and annual pricing.
- [Product — AXIOM SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-bold.xavainf.com/product): Explore the fictional AXIOM command-center product, interactive modules, workflow illustrations, and sample platform metrics.
- [Features — AXIOM SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-bold.xavainf.com/features): Browse illustrated automation, intelligence, analytics, and collaboration features in the AXIOM SaaS website demo.
- [Pricing — AXIOM SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-bold.xavainf.com/pricing): Compare sample AXIOM plans and switch between monthly and annual prices. This demonstration does not process payments or provision accounts.
- [Case Studies — AXIOM SaaS Demo](https://vibed-saas-bold.xavainf.com/case-studies): Explore fictional AXIOM customer stories and sample outcomes, presented as an editorial SaaS marketing demonstration.
